產業問題與工程挑戰

設備文件與專家意見可能在同一問題上給出不同答案，查到相關段落仍需要判斷適用版本。 系統須保存每項主張的出處、文件版本和權威規則，並讓專家追查判斷。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

把來源專屬的知識卡、權威裁決及人工審查接入問答流程。

成果

回答附有可回查的引用與版本選用理由，並支援專家覆核。

  • 可追溯知識卡及技術問答流程
  • 衝突判斷依據與專家審查介面
  • 版本與引用評測方法

驗證與證據

Anonymized Engineering Case · Engineering Evaluation

Resolve conflicts between source documents before answering, and retain citations and version choices.

Open full English page 繁體中文 Plan a project Technical diagram

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Equipment manuals and expert notes may disagree. Finding a relevant passage still leaves the question of which version applies. The system must retain claim provenance, document version and authority rules so that experts can audit a decision.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The question-answering workflow connects source-specific knowledge cards, conflict decisions and human review.

Outcome

Answers include traceable citations and a version-selection rationale. Experts can review the decisions.

  • Traceable knowledge cards and question-answering workflow
  • Conflict rationale and expert review interface
  • Version and citation evaluation method

Validation and evidence

The historical evaluation checks version selection and citations separately. An abstention can score well on version selection, so this page reports citation results with their test-set context.

85% historical citation accuracy on the original 28-question evaluation.

Public evidence classification · Measured benchmark · Illustrative demonstration

Citation accuracy in a historical evaluation · Measured
85 % · The original project evaluated the cited sources against a reference set of 28 questions. This applies to that question set, corpus and system version. The questions themselves are unavailable for public review.
